name: UCSF-PDGM-VQA
description: Brain tumor diagnosis is largely dependent on Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) evaluation, which requires radiologists to synthesize thousands of images across multiple 3D sequences and longitudinal studies. This process requires advanced neuro-radiology training, poses substantial cognitive load, and is highly time-consuming. Despite increasing demands in radiology, this expertise is difficult to scale, straining the current health systems. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide an opportunity to reduce this burden through a semi-automated, interactive interpretation of complex brain MRIs.
